title: The capability registry's index
description: registry.json: the areas items are filed under, and the consumers who may record demand. Items live in items/<area>.json as arrays of xfb/capability-item-1.

owner.description: The consumer id that owns primary details (stage, evidence, health, priority, surface, verification, limits, quirks, known issues).

title.description: How they're addressed, e.g. 'XF · Story Engine'.

requirements_doc.description: Their own requirements document, if any.
